author: Claude (draft for owner approval)
status: approved working baseline (owner 2026-10-30) + editorial verification corrections
method: Editorial peak-career judgments on the roster scale (50 limited, 70 capable, 85 specialist, 95 exceptional). Not measured data; not taken from any video game or proprietary rating. work_rate = pressing and tracking intensity. stamina = sustaining output. composure = decisions under pressure (NOT finishing); first drafted, then linearly stretched (80 + 1.5 x (draft - 86)) because the draft spread was too narrow (sd 6.3) to matter. agility = acceleration, balance, turning in tight space. marking = defensive READING (anticipation, positioning, interception timing), deliberately separated from def (tackling/duels); a first draft tracked def too closely (residual sd 2.6) and was re-rated (residual sd 7.1).

roy-keane.rationale: Relentless ball-winner and organiser; on-ball calm under pressure strong, temperament is a discipline issue not composure.

paul-scholes.rationale: Tireless runner in his prime but a poor, mistimed tackler; elite calm in tight spaces.

ryan-giggs.rationale: Explosive turn and change of direction; tracked back on the flank but never a reader of play.

michael-essien.rationale: Box-to-box engine; covered every blade of grass with real defensive reading.

frank-lampard.rationale: Exceptional durability and late-box runs; not an agile dribbler, average defensive positioning.

claude-makelele.rationale: Defined the screening role: anticipation and positioning over physicality.

kevin-de-bruyne.rationale: Presses with intent and covers ground; defending positionally is not his game.

rodri.rationale: Positional anchor with outstanding calm on the ball; not quick over short distances.

bernardo-silva.rationale: Unusually industrious technician; tight-space agility and pressing work rate are standout.

gilberto-silva.rationale: The "invisible wall": disciplined screening and reading, low flair.

patrick-vieira.rationale: Dominant all-round midfielder; long-striding rather than nimble.

robert-pires.rationale: Graceful, balanced wide playmaker; contributed off the ball but rarely defended deep.

xabi-alonso.rationale: Metronome with superb reading of danger; limited acceleration.

steven-gerrard.rationale: Huge energy and drive; positional discipline was not his strength.

javier-mascherano.rationale: Ferocious presser and cover defender; reads danger exceptionally.

ngolo-kante.rationale: Benchmark for work rate and ball recovery; anticipation as much as legs.

yaya-toure.rationale: Powerful carrier with great composure; off-ball pressing work rate was a known weakness at his peak.

eden-hazard.rationale: Elite low-centre-of-gravity agility; minimal defensive contribution by design.

juan-roman-riquelme.rationale: Pure enganche: dictated tempo with total calm; did not press or track.

ricardo-quaresma.rationale: Quick, tricky winger; erratic decision-making and little defensive work.

edgar-davids.rationale: "Pitbull": pressing intensity and agility; tackling more than positional reading.

roberto-baggio.rationale: Balletic close control and supreme calm; not a defensive contributor.

adriano.rationale: Explosive power striker at his Inter peak; low off-ball work and fitness consistency.

javier-zanetti.rationale: Legendary durability and two-way discipline; calm, intelligent defender.

michael-ballack.rationale: Complete midfielder with genuine defensive reading; not nimble.

paolo-maldini.rationale: Benchmark for defensive positioning and calm; read play rather than dived in.

ronaldo-nazario.rationale: Peak R9: unmatched acceleration with the ball, ice-cold one-on-one; no defensive role.

thomas-gravesen.rationale: Combative holding midfielder; snapped into challenges, limited turning speed.

jay-jay-okocha.rationale: Showman with sensational agility; inconsistent off-ball work.

nemanja-vidic.rationale: Commanding, brave positional defender; slow on the turn.

gabriel-batistuta.rationale: Powerful finisher; worked the channels but little defending.

francesco-totti.rationale: Visionary false nine with great calm; selective pressing.

giorgio-chiellini.rationale: Elite marker and physical duellist; not agile, composure decent rather than elite.

alvaro-recoba.rationale: Wand of a left foot; notoriously low work rate and fitness.

sinisa-mihajlovic.rationale: Reads play well from deep; slow, not a presser; dead-ball specialist (setPiece flag candidate).

nani.rationale: Quick, tricky and athletic; decision-making inconsistent.

dimitar-berbatov.rationale: Languid genius: supreme calm and touch, minimal pressing.

yannick-bolasie.rationale: Energetic, tricky winger who works; decision-making is the weakness.

rio-ferdinand.rationale: Ball-playing defender who read danger early; famously calm.

obafemi-martins.rationale: Explosive acceleration; willing runner; erratic finishing decisions.

michael-owen.rationale: Electric acceleration and cool finishing at his peak; no defending.

jaap-stam.rationale: Powerful, aggressive marker; not quick on the turn.

lilian-thuram.rationale: Quick, intelligent and calm; among the best readers of his era.

denilson.rationale: Step-over specialist with exceptional agility; little end product or defending.

alessandro-del-piero.rationale: Elegant, intelligent forward; more work rate than most luxury forwards.

pablo-aimar.rationale: Slight, darting playmaker; tight-space agility elite.

antonio-cassano.rationale: Gifted but low work rate and conditioning.

andres-dalessandro.rationale: Feisty, agile playmaker; intermittent defensive work.

zlatan-ibrahimovic.rationale: Unusually agile for his size; supreme confidence; selective pressing.

lucio.rationale: Athletic, aggressive, loved forward surges that left gaps; more duel-winner than reader.

hatem-ben-arfa.rationale: Dazzling dribbler; low tactical work and decision consistency.

rivaldo.rationale: Languid but decisive; big-moment calm; little pressing.

marcel-desailly.rationale: "The Rock": power and positional authority; not nimble.

zinedine-zidane.rationale: Supreme calm and balance in tight spaces; modest defensive work.

ronaldinho.rationale: Peak Barcelona: dazzling agility and audacious calm; minimal defending.

djalminha.rationale: Outrageous technician; low work rate and volatile temperament.

steed-malbranque.rationale: Industrious, nimble link player; limited defensive reading.

ricardo-carvalho.rationale: Clever, anticipating defender; calm, quick across the ground.

ledley-king.rationale: Famously clean, calm defending; chronic knee problems limit stamina.

tugay-kerimoglu.rationale: Composed deep passer; slow but reads play reasonably.

morten-gamst-pedersen.rationale: Hard-working wide midfielder with a strong left foot (setPiece flag candidate).

nene.rationale: Skilful left-footed attacker; little defensive work.

changes.reason: Famously unhurried in possession under pressure; draft under-rated composed non-creators.
Calm, simple, error-free distribution; the composure of a screen, not a creator.
Rarely lost the ball under pressure; temperament is discipline, not on-ball composure.
Composed enough to play centre-back for an elite possession side.
Calm, low-risk ball retention after recoveries.
Carried the ball through pressure with authority.
Assured on the ball in a deep role; occasional rashness is in tackling, not decisions.
Secure in possession; drafted too low relative to creators.
Press-resistant carrier; drafted too low relative to creators.
Rash in positioning (reflected in marking) but composed on the ball during forward carries.
Peak window 1996-98 preceded the knee injuries; 72 reflected later career.
Exceptional body control and balance for his size.
